prompt: Use case: game skybox. Asset type: seamless 360-degree equirectangular panoramic sky. Primary request: early morning sky over the rugged Taihang mountains of northern China in late September, sun just above the eastern horizon at a low angle, warm golden light on the horizon fading into cool pale blue overhead, thin layers of morning mist and haze near the horizon, a few soft wispy high clouds, distant layered blue-grey mountain silhouettes along the entire horizon line. Style/medium: photorealistic matte painting. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no people, no buildings, no lens flare, no sun disc drawn as a hard circle.
